provider: OpenXLab 浦源 (Shanghai AI Lab) — model + dataset centers

free_tier.stated: Not published, and this is the honest finding. The platform's own intro describes the model center as building an object-storage layer specifically for large files — verbatim: '基于平台内的命令行工具，便于 AI 开发者上传和发布模型文件，搭建对象存储体系，提供大文件存储能力，快速上传下载功能，便于 AI 开发者进行模型存储' (object storage system providing large-file storage capability). The dataset center supports private datasets as well as public ones. the openxlab.org.cn docs tree 504'd repeatedly and the upload pages contain no quota statement.

egress.terms: No egress meter found; public models and datasets are anonymously downloadable. Reads are CDN-served. Unverified at the header level because model-detail pages timed out from this network.

tooling: pip install openxlab, then first-party subcommands: `openxlab dataset upload-file`, `openxlab dataset upload-folder`, `openxlab model upload ...` with --dataset-repo/--source-path/--target-path. Python SDK mirrors the CLI (upload_file / upload_folder). Also git+LFS. Real, named, documented client — this passes the tooling filter cleanly.
chaining: Repos are per-user and per-org and free to create, so capacity is N repos. OpenXLab is the Shanghai AI Lab's public front door (InternLM, OpenDataLab datasets), so its per-repo sizes are already in the tens-of-GB range. Multiplying across accounts is easy but the per-account ceiling is unknown.
limits_note: Unverified. dataset upload supports 文件/文件夹/压缩包 with server-side auto-extract for archives (a 50 GB zip becomes an extracted tree — that is a quota-relevant behaviour, since the extracted size can exceed the archive). No published per-file cap, retention period, or rate limit found.

identity_cost.detail: email, plus likely +86 phone — Chinese platform, and prior rounds recorded the pans in this family demanding real-name verification.

reliability_note: Model pages return 302 to login for detail views.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: read live: model center provides '对象存储体系，提供大文件存储能力' and the dataset center supports '私有数据集的上传、管理和发布'
read live: three upload modes (file / folder / archive with auto-extract), plus CLI and Python SDK (`pip install openxlab`, `openxlab dataset upload-folder`)
